name: maxitexs-sorteo
description: Sorteo en vivo Corporación Maxitex’s — React + Vite + Express + PostgreSQL

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @maxitexs/api & npm run dev -w @maxitexs/web

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @maxitexs/shared && npm run typecheck -w @maxitexs/api && npm run typecheck -w @maxitexs/web
